@@ -0,0 +1,51 @@
+package config
+
+import (
+	"math"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestTracingConfigValidation(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, ratio := range []float64{0, 0.5, 1} {
+		cfg := TracingConfig{SamplingRatio: ratio}
+		require.NoError(t, cfg.validate())
+	}
+
+	for _, ratio := range []float64{-0.1, 1.1, math.NaN()} {
+		cfg := TracingConfig{SamplingRatio: ratio}
+		require.EqualError(t, cfg.validate(), "sampling ratio should be a number between 0 and 1")
+	}
+
+	for _, propagator := range []TracingPropagator{
+		TracingPropagatorTraceContext, TracingPropagatorBaggage, TracingPropagatorB3,
+		TracingPropagatorB3Multi, TracingPropagatorJaeger, TracingPropagatorXRay,
+		TracingPropagatorOTTrace, TracingPropagatorNone,
+	} {
+		cfg := TracingConfig{SamplingRatio: 1, Propagators: []TracingPropagator{propagator}}
+		require.NoError(t, cfg.validate())
+	}
+
+	cfg := TracingConfig{SamplingRatio: 1, Propagators: []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorB3, "unknown"}}
+	require.EqualError(t, cfg.validate(), "invalid propagator option: unknown")
+}
+
+func TestTracingConfigLoad(t *testing.T) {
+	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yml")
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte("tracing:\n  samplingRatio: 0.5\n  propagators: [b3multi, jaeger]\n"), 0600))
+	result, err := Load(path)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, 0.5, result.Config.Tracing.SamplingRatio)
+	require.Equal(t, []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorB3Multi, TracingPropagatorJaeger}, result.Config.Tracing.Propagators)
+
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte("tracing:\n  samplingRatio: 2\n"), 0600))
+	_, err = Load(path)
+	require.EqualError(t, err, "sampling ratio should be a number between 0 and 1")
+
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte("tracing:\n  propagators: [unknown]\n"), 0600))
+	_, err = Load(path)
+	require.EqualError(t, err, "invalid propagator option: unknown")
+}

+// NewPropagator creates a composite propagator from the configured formats.
+func NewPropagator(formats []config.TracingPropagator) propagation.TextMapPropagator {
+	propagators := make([]propagation.TextMapPropagator, 0, len(formats))
+	for _, format := range formats {
+		switch format {
+		case config.TracingPropagatorTraceContext:
+			propagators = append(propagators, propagation.TraceContext{})
+		case config.TracingPropagatorBaggage:
+			propagators = append(propagators, propagation.Baggage{})
+		case config.TracingPropagatorB3:
+			propagators = append(propagators, b3.New())
+		case config.TracingPropagatorB3Multi:

+		case config.TracingPropagatorJaeger:

+		case config.TracingPropagatorXRay:
+			propagators = append(propagators, xray.Propagator{})

+			propagators = append(propagators, ot.OT{})

+		}

@@ -0,0 +1,59 @@
+package tracing
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/propagation"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace"
+)
+
+func TestProviderSamplingRatio(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tt := range []struct {
+		ratio     float64
+		recording bool
+	}{
+		{ratio: 0, recording: false},
+		{ratio: 1, recording: true},
+	} {
+		provider, err := NewProvider(context.Background(), "test", tt.ratio)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		_, span := provider.Tracer("test").Start(context.Background(), "root")
+		require.Equal(t, tt.recording, span.IsRecording())
+		span.End()
+		require.NoError(t, provider.Shutdown(context.Background()))
+	}
+}
+
+func TestNewPropagator(t *testing.T) {
+	spanContext := trace.NewSpanContext(trace.SpanContextConfig{
+		TraceID:    trace.TraceID{1},
+		SpanID:     trace.SpanID{2},
+		TraceFlags: trace.FlagsSampled,
+	})
+	ctx := trace.ContextWithSpanContext(context.Background(), spanContext)
+
+	for _, tt := range []struct {
+		format config.TracingPropagator
+		field  string
+	}{
+		{config.TracingPropagatorTraceContext, "traceparent"},
+		{config.TracingPropagatorB3, "b3"},
+		{config.TracingPropagatorB3Multi, "x-b3-traceid"},
+		{config.TracingPropagatorJaeger, "uber-trace-id"},
+		{config.TracingPropagatorXRay, "X-Amzn-Trace-Id"},
+		{config.TracingPropagatorOTTrace, "ot-tracer-traceid"},
+	} {
+		t.Run(string(tt.format), func(t *testing.T) {
+			carrier := propagation.MapCarrier{}
+			NewPropagator([]config.TracingPropagator{tt.format}).Inject(ctx, carrier)
+			require.NotEmpty(t, carrier.Get(tt.field))
+		})
+	}
+
+	carrier := propagation.MapCarrier{}
+	NewPropagator([]config.TracingPropagator{config.TracingPropagatorNone}).Inject(ctx, carrier)
+	require.Empty(t, carrier)
+}
